eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent and Cloud Computing (ICoICC) provides a platform for researchers, academicians, and industry professionals to share advancements in intelligent computing, big data, cloud technologies, and next-generation communication systems. The conference focuses on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Big Data analytics, Agentic AI, and Explainable AI, along with applications in healthcare, finance, agriculture, and smart systems. It also covers IoT, 5G/6G communications, and their integration with cloud environments. Emphasis is placed on cloud, fog, and edge computing, including scalable architectures and sustainable solutions. Security, privacy, blockchain, and post-quantum cryptography are key themes. Emerging paradigms such as digital twins, cyber-physical systems, metaverse, AR/VR, and human-AI interaction are also explored, aligning with standards of IEEE.
